title: Inner Space
description: A body, seen from the inside at the scale of its cells. Unlocks the Miniaturiser that takes you there, and the materials of its five regions: plasma, matrix fibre, memory cells, nucleotides and tumour specimens. In its Tumour, a Metastatic Spore calls the Tumour Hydra.

puzzle.goal: A body of size l moves at speed u through a fluid of density p and viscosity m. Write the ratio R of its inertia to the fluid's stickiness, which says whether inertia or stickiness wins.
puzzle.name: Reynolds number
puzzle.ask: Find R for a swimming bacterium: p = @{p} kg/m³, u = 0.00003 m/s, l = 0.000002 m, m = @{m} Pa·s.
puzzle.method: Inertia goes as p·u², stickiness as m·u/l; their ratio is p·u·l/m. Small enough, and nothing coasts: stop pushing and you stop dead (Purcell's "Life at Low Reynolds Number").
